**Finding: missing** (TRANSITION — medium severity)

The agreement is a hosted e-business services deal, yet it contains no exit provision. Section 3.5 "Effect of Termination" deals only with Customer's accrued payment obligations; Sections 11.6 and 14.18 address Content responsibility and contact data, not return or deletion, and searches for "transition" and "delete" returned nothing. Because there is no data return right at all, the clause fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export).

Redline (validated, ok:true): a new paragraph inserted after p0049 in Section 3.5 — which already survives termination under Section 14.2 — requiring IBM to (a) provide up to six months' transition assistance at then-current rates, (b) return all Content in a machine-readable format within 30 days, and (c) thereafter delete and certify deletion. The comment flags a 90-day assistance window as our available fallback.
